# Blood Stone

> Blood Stone is a new rock/metal band forged in Middelburg, Netherlands, currently seeking a lead vocalist.

Blood Stone draws its sound and visual identity from the intensity and precision of Damascus steel. The site's purpose is to introduce the band, let visitors stream demo tracks, and recruit a lead vocalist.

## Content

- [Who We Are](https://bloodstone.nl/#who-we-are): Background on the band, formed in 2024 in Middelburg.
- [Transmissions](https://bloodstone.nl/#transmissions): Streamable demo tracks via the on-page music player.
- [The Ritual](https://bloodstone.nl/#ritual): Application form for vocalists wanting to join the band, sent via Formspree.

## Contact

- Email: info@bloodstone.nl
